numerical_recovery.diagnostic_observation: Forward values and head gradients were finite; 110 LoRA parameter gradients became nonfinite before clipping. The same clean state/batch/RNG reproduced this under automatic SDPA, while MATH replay and a fresh100-step MATH prefix remained finite.
numerical_recovery.fix: Use MATH SDPA only for live CUDA candidate training forward; reject nonfinite head/LoRA gradient norms before optimizer.step; retain automatic eval/cache encoding.
numerical_recovery.backend_policy: Previously completed Baby/Sports LoRA groups retain automatic SDPA. All six Clothing LoRA groups use MATH training SDPA; Clothing frozen42 is reused and has no LoRA training. Cached encoding remains automatic. Backend trajectories are not asserted bitwise identical, and cross-domain differences are conditional on these numerical configurations.
